concepts: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production concept art target for the playable Space Patriot game, grounded industrial sci-fi. Single wide 16:10 image, physically plausible 3D game render from the seated pilot's exact eye point, looking straight ahead, horizontal 84-degree view. Compact old working courier cockpit, cabin width 3.6m, angular welded off-white pressure shell with olive charcoal structural ribs, scuffed edges and rubber seals. Large forward trapezoid windshield fills upper half, unobstructed distant rocky coastal spaceport under overcast blue-grey sky. Thick sloping side window frames, not a central pillar. Dashboard lower half is an integrated sloping wraparound console with THREE readable inset amber/green MFDs, chamfered dark housings, individual physical toggle switches with safety guards, circuit breakers, rotary knobs, printed tiny stencils. Main middle MFD larger with circular radar and altitude ladder. Two smaller side MFDs. Left throttle lever and right flight grip partially in foreground, braided cable behind console, bolted maintenance access below window. Restrained amber task lamps under overhead brow, soft bounce lighting so EVERY SURFACE is readable, no black voids. Warm ivory paint, desaturated olive, charcoal rubber, exposed satin steel. Strong hierarchy of big surfaces / structural details / tiny fasteners, no random greeble, no neon strips, no holograms, no hexagon wallpaper. Highly considered original hard-surface design with believable human ergonomics. No people, no HUD overlay, no collage, no text outside the scene. This exact frame will be reconstructed as an actual Unity scene.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production game environment concept board for Space Patriot: four equal 16:10 panels arranged 2 by 2 in one wide image, modest discreet labels COURIER / HABITATION / ENGINEERING / FREIGHT. Cohesive original grounded working spacecraft interiors with believable human dimensions, warm off-white pressure shell, desaturated olive metal, charcoal rubber, restrained ochre safety paint, scuffed touch surfaces and brushed steel. Top left: compact courier rear cabin, seat back foreground, two fabric bunks inset into left wall with privacy curtains, strapped supply bags and right foldaway galley, narrow clear aisle and chamfered aft airlock. Top right: medium vessel habitation mess with bolted table, built-in benches with worn brown cushions, individual lockers, coffee flask, inset bunks visible through doorway. Bottom left: engineering room with twin cylindrical reactor coolant vessels cradled in ribbed frames, physically routed thick pipes in wall raceways, maintenance walkway, a readable amber breaker console, pressure gauges and labeled access hatches. Bottom right: freight hold with overhead hoist on rails, floor tie-down tracks, ribbed structural bays, strapped cargo containers in side lanes, a clear central loading aisle and an open pressure ramp. Eye-height wide-lens architectural views, realistic soft task lighting with warm work lamps and cool fill, every space legible and navigable. High quality 3D game art target, manufactured layered materials, deliberate purposeful detail, consistent visual language. Avoid empty generic corridors, random greebles, blue neon, giant glowing reactor balls, paper-thin flat boxes.

Use case: stylized-concept. Space Patriot original ship design production board. Four distinct grounded industrial spacecraft, separated cleanly on a pale warm grey studio background, arranged 2x2, entire vehicle fully in frame, 3/4 front elevated camera view, crisp shadows, high quality realistic hard surface game modeling. Labels KESTREL / MULE / SPUR / MANTA. KESTREL 24m courier: compact deep-bodied lifting hull, broad angular windshield integrated into a raised pressure cabin, short clipped swept wings, twin thick engine nacelles on separate aft pylons with open gaps around them, short blunt faceted nose with sensor turret below, substantial retractable articulated landing legs, subtle ochre registration band. MULE 50m freighter: blunt forward cab above an underslung central freight tunnel, exposed longitudinal trusses flanking six standard corrugated shipping pods, four chunky rear thrusters, box cargo volumes contrasted with rounded pressure tanks and chamfered cab. SPUR 42m salvage tug: asymmetric offset cockpit to port, articulated crane and open claw to starboard, rugged aft engine block, cylindrical pressure hull, exposed radial radiators, utility orange crane and charcoal ship. MANTA 32m survey craft: truly broad curved manta-wing planform with swept tapered edges, protected center canopy, two embedded engines leaving distinct exhaust channels, an underslung rotating sensor dish, bone ceramic armor and desaturated olive inset panels. Realistic material scale, 70% calm primary surface, 20% structural paneling, 10% machinery. Detailed bevels, visible wall thickness, dark recessed seams, maintenance access, RCS clusters, readable thrust direction and balance. No flat pancake hulls, no generic toy boxes, no identical silhouette with different wings. No copying an existing franchise.

Use case: stylized-concept. Single wide 16:10 production environment concept frame for Space Patriot, eye-height walking view at a working freight spaceport on a temperate frontier planet. Grounded industrial science fiction, restrained architecture. Foreground rough repaired concrete apron with drainage grilles, embedded freight tracks and faded yellow lane markings. Left a large recessed hangar with thick chamfered structural arch, raised segmented blast doors, visible roof crane, work lights, equipment bays and a parked worn courier spacecraft. Right a three-storey operations building of warm concrete and olive metal, external stairs, recessed windows and rooftop air-handling machines; ground-floor freight desk and cargo loading area with ribbed containers and pipe gantries. Center clear pedestrian route into small dense spaceport district, covered walkways, antennas, atmospheric towers, sparse workers for scale. Behind buildings a CONTINUOUS natural landscape: rolling rocky hills with layered geology, wind-bent conifers, tawny native grass, distant coast and mountains smoothly reaching horizon; no square terrain, no floating blocks. Overcast late afternoon light, bright enough to read shapes, warm amber practical lamps. Original coherent authored game environment, rich physical materials at believable scale, differentiated building silhouettes. No cyberpunk neon, no holograms, no repeating cubes, no oversized logos. Highly detailed but feasible Unity browser game scene.
